meta.title: Destinations | TourLink
meta.description: Explore Central Asia country by country — Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, and Turkmenistan. Route ideas and planning tips from TourLink DMC.

hero.title: Central Asia,
hero.description: Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, and Turkmenistan are close on the map. But a good trip still needs the right order.
hero.note: TourLink is based in Uzbekistan and plans trips across all five countries when route, season, borders, and pace allow a coherent line.

countries.title: Five countries, one connected region
countries.description: Start with one country and expand the route only when the trip truly needs a wider Central Asian arc.

uzbekistan.name: Uzbekistan
uzbekistan.description: Silk Road cities, crafts, architecture, and tightly logical routes.

tajikistan.name: Tajikistan
tajikistan.description: Where the Pamir touches the sky

how_to_choose.title: The map is wide. The route should be clear.
how_to_choose.description: TourLink sees Central Asia as one connected region, but not every trip needs all five countries. A strong route has a center, a reason to expand, and enough breathing room between places.

center.title: Start from the center
center.description: Pick one main country first. That gives the trip a center, not just a list of border crossings.

expand.title: Expand with purpose
expand.description: Add neighboring countries when they strengthen the story, landscape, or season.

pace.title: Keep the pace
pace.description: Transfers, borders, and rest nights are visible from the start so the trip keeps air between places.

route_map.title: An example line across the region
route_map.description: The line shows how a multi-country route fits on one Central Asian map. It is a guide, not a ready-made tour program.

route_ideas.title: How a trip might come together
route_ideas.description: This is a first draft. The real program is built around dates, access, and pace.

uzbekistan_intro.title: First route through Uzbekistan
uzbekistan_intro.description: Start in Tashkent, link Silk Road cities, and add a mountain or desert pause only if the pace allows.

uz_kg.title: Silk Road cities and mountain roads
uz_kg.description: Connect Uzbekistan with Kyrgyzstan when an urban route needs mountain air and a softer active rhythm.

regional.title: A wider Central Asia route
regional.description: Kazakhstan, Tajikistan, or Turkmenistan add a wider cultural, mountain, or desert arc when the trip has room for it.

planning_checks.title: What TourLink checks in advance
planning_checks.description: The route feels calmer when these decisions are made before hotels and detailed scheduling.

access.title: Borders and permits
access.description: Some routes stay within one country easily; others need borders, permits, or a cleaner order.

season.title: Season and comfort
season.description: Mountains, deserts, and city walks work differently in spring, summer, autumn, and winter.

movement.title: Distances and rhythm
movement.description: Flights, trains, road days, and buffer nights are chosen before the program becomes detailed.

cta.title: Want to build the
cta.description: Share dates, pace, and your first country. We will suggest a route that keeps the region connected without overloading the trip.
